profile_text.body:
AI Now Institute is a nonprofit founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York, NY. Its site says it challenges and reimagines the current trajectory for AI, and it publishes research and commentary from its staff on AI policy and industry conduct.

Several staff members are named on the site. Boyan Milanov, a Senior Research Scientist, argues that AI doomerism is not based on scientific work and that calls for regulation from inside the industry are in reality attempts by AI companies to set their own standards. Aya Ibrahim warned against one-size-fits-all security steps after NVIDIA announced a new agent safety platform. Heidy Khlaaf, the Chief AI Scientist, said that acknowledging the harms of AI technology would not be profitable for AI companies, and in an op-ed wrote that high-risk industries from aviation to banking are subject to independent oversight and meaningful penalties, and that AI companies should be no exception.

The institute's profile lists no products and no lawsuits. A law exposure entry for New York carries a count of 458.
